page_title: RMA 2-1 RSO | Real Madrid v Real Sociedad 17/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Real Sociedad) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
90+4' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by David Alaba (Real Madrid) was quite harsh and Cesar Soto Grado didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+3' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Kepa Arrizabalaga, who smothers the ball.
90+3' Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
90+2' The corner from Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) is hurriedly cleared.
90+2' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

90+1' A great cross finds Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) in space and his bullet header towards the bottom left corner looks destined for the net, but Alex Remiro brilliantly tips the ball round the post.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Real Sociedad) latched on to a cross on the edge of the box, but his strike isn't accurate at all and the ball goes way wide of the left post.
89' Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle. Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) commits a foul after dangerous play.
87' Carlo Ancelotti decides to make a substitution. Federico Valverde will be replaced by Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid).
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) is coming onto the pitch as Rodrygo cannot continue after picking up an injury.
87' The shot by Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Kepa Arrizabalaga.
86' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

85' That's unlucky! Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. The ball goes behind for a corner. Real Madrid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
83' Corner kick. Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) is ready to send the ball into the box.
81' Imanol Alguacil has decided to substitute Mikel Oyarzabal and he is replaced by Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad).
81' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Brais Mendez walks off the pitch to be replaced by Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad).
81' That's the end of the game for Ander Barrenetxea, who is replaced by Mohamed-Ali Cho (Real Sociedad).
80' A rebound falls kindly for Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!
80' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.

78' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom right corner, but Alex Remiro was alert and the score remained the same.
77' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!
74' Here's the change. Fran Garcia leaves the pitch and Nacho Fernandez (Real Madrid) comes on as a substitute.
73' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
71' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Cesar Soto Grado had an easy-decision to make.
70' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from mid-range. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance!
69' Substitution. Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) in, Kieran Tierney out.
68' Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) has tested the patience of referee Cesar Soto Grado and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
66' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Robin Le Normand (Real Sociedad) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
66' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
62' Joselu comes off the pitch to be replaced by Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid).
62' Carlo Ancelotti prepares a substitution. Aurelien Tchouameni is replaced by Luka Modric (Real Madrid).

60' 2 - 1 The ball hits the back of the net! Fran Garcia showcases his brilliant technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Joselu (Real Madrid) gets onto the scoresheet by sweetly heading it low inside the left post – 2:1.
60' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
57' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
55' Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
54' Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
52' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
50' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
49' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) is penalised for a foul. Cesar Soto Grado had a clear view and blows his whistle.
46' 1 - 1 Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) receives a precise pass just outside the box and produces a glorious strike into the left side of the goal off the post. The goalkeeper was helpless.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) commits a rough challenge and Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for a foul. Real Sociedad win a free kick.
45+2' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) is flagged offside and it's not the first time today.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
44' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

44' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Real Sociedad are awarded a corner kick.
41' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Cesar Soto Grado blows for a foul.
41' Kieran Tierney (Real Sociedad) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
40' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
37' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
35' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) picks up a loose pass and unexpectedly unleashes a howitzer from distance, but the effort comes to nothing as a defender gets in the block.
34' Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
33' Cesar Soto Grado shows a yellow card to Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) for his blatant foul.
33' Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
32' A cross from a corner kick by Real Sociedad is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

31' What a save from Kepa Arrizabalaga! Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out. Corner kick. Real Sociedad will have an opportunity.
30' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) commits a foul and Cesar Soto Grado immediately signals a free kick.

30' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands.
30' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a superb stop.
29' Joselu (Real Madrid) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
29' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the middle of the goal, but Alex Remiro pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
28' The ball is cleared after Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
26' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) takes a good first touch from the pass, but mishits his shot low towards the middle of the goal and allows the Alex Remiro to make a comfortable save.
24' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) receives a lofted pass from out wide and shoots from close range, but the ball flies way wide of the right-hand post.
24' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
23' Robin Le Normand (Real Sociedad) commits a rough foul. Cesar Soto Grado stops the game and makes a call. A free kick has been awarded to Real Madrid.
21' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
19' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

18' Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) anticipates the lofted pass and races into the box with just the keeper to beat. He shoots early towards the bottom right corner, but Alex Remiro pulls off a great save to deny him.
17' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) leans back and sends a volley well wide of the left post from inside the box.
16' A great pass puts Joselu (Real Madrid) clear inside the box, he sidesteps the keeper but inexplicably hit his shot off the crossbar.
15' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Fran Garcia (Real Madrid).
14' Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
11' A goal, which was scored by Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad), was disallowed due to offside.
10' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
7' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Alex Remiro is alert and denies him.
5' 0 - 1 Goal! Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) is quickest to react to the rebound and stabs the ball into the back of the net. It's 0:1.
5' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) races onto a cross inside the box and lets fly with a powerful effort, but Kepa Arrizabalaga makes a fantastic reaction save to deny him.
4' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
3' Cesar Soto Grado blows for a foul after Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
2' The game is interrupted. Robin Le Normand (Real Sociedad) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Real Sociedad will kick-off.
Cesar Soto Grado will officiate today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
